description: Named variables of the Groaner's behaviour (chara/Groaner/behavior.lua reads and writes them by name). Each character instance owns a small block of bytes; every entry of "fields" names one value in it: "name" is the name the script uses, "kind" the storage type (s8, u8, s16, u16, s32, u32: a write keeps the low bits, a read sign- or zero-extends), "at" the byte offset in the block (absent: the next naturally aligned offset), "note" what the value means. Values are raw integers in the units the behaviour uses (usually Q12, 4096 = 1.0 or 1 m; angles Q12, 4096 = a full turn). A mod adds or changes fields with a state.json of the same path; keep the offsets of fields the behaviour already uses.

fields.name: groaner_sense_scale
fields.note: Q12 scale of the reach of its sight and hearing, 0 = the game's (4096 the same); a script sets it each tick for a sharper or duller Groaner, since its start clears the block
